desc: Derive the pair-state palindrome construction: from center states, matching incoming/outgoing edge labels extend a palindrome by two.

Develop and verify the final efficient parity-separated BFS implementation with grouped labeled adjacency.
Analyze dense-graph transition cost and apply practical iteration/queue optimizations.
Provide the required stdin/stdout Python solution enclosed in code delimiters.
